messages.content: What type of personality am I?

function.name: calculate_big_five_traits
function.description: Calculate the big five personality traits based on a set of questions answered by the user. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

answers.description: Answers to a set of questions rated on a scale from 1 to 5.

calculate_percentile.description: If true, the percentile rank for each trait will also be calculated.

average_answers.description: If true, answers will be averaged across each trait's questions.

message.content:
Sure! Let’s start by getting a quick snapshot of your personality using the **Big Five** framework (Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness, Neuroticism). I’ll give you a short set of statements—rate each one on a scale from **1 (Strongly Disagree)** to **5 (Strongly Agree)**. Once you’ve filled them out, I’ll calculate your scores and give you a brief interpretation.

---

### Quick Personality Questionnaire

| # | Statement | Your Rating (1–5) |
|---|-----------|-------------------|
| 1 | I enjoy trying new experiences and ideas. |   |
| 2 | I am usually organized and plan ahead. |   |
| 3 | I feel energized when I’m around other people. |   |
| 4 | I am considerate and try to avoid hurting others. |   |
| 5 | I often worry about things that might go wrong. |   |
| 6 | I like to read books or learn about new topics. |   |
| 7 | I prefer to keep my schedule flexible rather than rigid. |   |
| 8 | I enjoy social gatherings and meeting new people. |   |
| 9 | I am careful and pay attention to details. |   |
|10 | I get upset easily when things don’t go as planned. |   |

> **Tip:** Think about how you would answer each statement in everyday life. No right or wrong answers—just honest ones!

Once you’ve filled in your ratings, reply with the numbers in order (e.g., `5, 4, 3, 2, 1, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1`). I’ll crunch the numbers and tell you what type of personality you have according to the Big Five.
